original_evidence.text: | Nix installer (DeterminateSystems/nix-installer) | https://github.com/DeterminateSystems/nix-installer.git | 4132ad07a15ee7d88c096ac7172b7afb2672866b / 2026-08-19 | Y | Y (single run, but downloads+installs+activates unattended) | Y | https by default (build-time `NIX_TARBALL_URL = "https://releases.nixos.org/nix/nix-2.35.2/..."`, flake.nix:37); **runtime code also accepts plain `http://` if a user overrides the URL** (`src/action/base/fetch_and_unpack_nix.rs:41-44,120-121`, no rejection of `http` scheme); TLS validation not disabled anywhere found (no InsecureSkipVerify/danger_accept_invalid) | N | **none** — downloaded `.tar.xz` is piped straight into `tar`/`xz` unpack with zero hash or signature check | n/a (no key at all) | `src/action/base/fetch_and_unpack_nix.rs:117-172` (fetch via reqwest → `res.bytes()` → `XzDecoder`/`tar::Archive::unpack`, no digest/signature check anywhere in path); confirmed via repo-wide grep for gpg/signature/sha256/checksum in `src/` = 0 hits. Note: the alternate `DeterminateNix` distribution is embedded at compile time (`include_bytes!`) so it has no runtime download step (`src/distribution.rs:33-51`) |

fields.label: transport
fields.value: https by default (build-time `NIX_TARBALL_URL = "https://releases.nixos.org/nix/nix-2.35.2/..."`, flake.nix:37); **runtime code also accepts plain `http://` if a user overrides the URL** (`src/action/base/fetch_and_unpack_nix.rs:41-44,120-121`, no rejection of `http` scheme); TLS validation not disabled anywhere found (no InsecureSkipVerify/danger_accept_invalid)

fields.label: payload_verification
fields.value: **none** — downloaded `.tar.xz` is piped straight into `tar`/`xz` unpack with zero hash or signature check

Note: the alternate `DeterminateNix` distribution is embedded at compile time (`include_bytes!`) so it has no runtime download step (`src/distribution.rs:33-51`)
